notes.title: Distribution of additional characters started! & Version 1.12 Update Notic
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24557393/8171ed5bc7d6783ab98d1c95d4a7bc3b963bd185.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you for waiting!![/b]

From today, "Trouble Witches Origin - Episode1 Daughters of Amalgam - " will finally start delivering DLC, "Cynfi", "Louis", "Conon", "Raya", for additional characters!

Use the power-up 4 people, aim for further score up!!

The bundle which packed four characters also started distribution.
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5582/Trouble_Witches_Origin_DELUXE_Additional_Character_Pack

[h1][b]Caution![/b]
If you buy a DLC included in the bundle, you can not purchase the bundle version.[/h1]

Also, with this DLC distribution, Ver1.12 was released.

[h1]Changes in version 1.12[/h1]

■Revamped "Leader Board" with additional character implementation

■Some bug fixes

notes.title: Trouble Witches Origin - Episode1 Daughters of Amalgam - ver1.11 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]■v1.11 Patch Details[/h1]

[b] ■New implement content[/b] 
[list]
[*]Implementation of "Achievements"
[/list]

[b] ■Game adjustment[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Correspondence adjustment of Xinput controller
[*]Fine adjustment of graphics
[*]Adjust game contents
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]* With this version upgrade, the setting of the "Pause Button" returns to the initial setting.
Thank you for your understanding.[/h1]
